review.tagline: Desktop app that runs parallel coding agents in git worktrees with a Kanban view
review.summary: Orchestrator.inc is a local desktop app with a background daemon that runs multiple coding agents side by side, each in its own branch and git worktree. A project-level orchestrator agent can plan work and spawn workers. A Kanban board tracks each worker's pull request, CI and review state, and can send failures or review comments back to the owning agent.
review.audience: Developers running several coding agents in parallel across one repository
strengths: Each Git-backed worker gets its own branch and worktree, avoiding branch collisions
Supports 30+ agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider, Gemini CLI and Goose
Kanban status is derived from session, PR, CI and review state
Desktop installers for macOS (arm64, Intel), Windows and Linux (AppImage, deb, rpm); no CLI needed
weaknesses: Desktop app only; no Docker or server deployment is documented
Worker, Chat and reviewer support differs per agent; a separate capability matrix is needed
macOS may block first launch and require right-click Open
Agent CLIs must be installed and configured separately; RAM requirements are unknown
needs: Needs Git, Agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
Models: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Aider
